mechanism: Leflunomide may increase uric acid levels and impair renal function, while chlorthalidone (a thiazide diuretic) also elevates uric acid and can cause electrolyte/renal complications, creating additive metabolic and renal effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and uric acid levels regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if gout history present; ensure adequate hydration and assess for signs of renal impairment.
